page.title: MAE AI
page.subtitle: Ask your engineering professor: concepts, step-by-step solutions, schematics and code.

mascot.greeting: Ready to help with your engineering questions!

states.idle: Mai, the MAE AI assistant, is ready

info.title: What MAE AI can do
items: Explain concepts with intuition and the math behind them
Solve problems step by step, with units checked
Read schematics and diagrams you upload
tips: Give component values and say what you need to find.
Attach a clear, well-lit image of the schematic.
Ask follow-ups: MAE AI remembers the last few messages.
info.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Verify results before relying on them.

composer.label: Message MAE AI
composer.placeholder: Ask a question, or paste a schematic image…
composer.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Verify results before relying on them.

general: Explain the difference between AC and DC in simple terms.
How do I choose between a buck and a boost converter?
What does the Laplace transform actually do?
I uploaded a schematic. Please walk me through what it does.
circuits: Find the Thevenin equivalent of a 12 V source with 4 Ω and 6 Ω resistors.
Explain mesh analysis versus nodal analysis.
Why does an RC circuit charge exponentially?
I uploaded a circuit schematic. Find the current through each resistor.
power: Explain how a buck converter regulates voltage.
How is the duty cycle related to the output voltage of a boost converter?
I uploaded an inverter schematic. Explain how it switches.
logic: Simplify F = A'B + AB' + AB with a Karnaugh map.
Explain the difference between a latch and a flip-flop.
How do I design a mod-5 counter?
I uploaded a logic diagram. What Boolean expression does it implement?
control: Explain how to read a root locus plot.
How do I tune a PID controller for a first-order plant?
What do gain and phase margin tell me about stability?
I uploaded a block diagram. Find the closed-loop transfer function.
code: Explain pointers in C with a small example.
Why does my loop run one time too many?
What does this 8086 assembly instruction do: MOV AX, [BX+SI]?
I uploaded a screenshot of an error. Help me debug it.
arduino: How do I read a potentiometer and dim an LED with PWM?
Explain the difference between delay() and millis().
How do I debounce a push button?
I uploaded my wiring diagram. Check it for mistakes.
signals: Explain convolution with a simple example.
What is the Nyquist rate and why does aliasing happen?
How do poles in the s-plane relate to system stability?
I uploaded a signal plot. What is its Fourier transform?
fluid: How does a double-acting cylinder differ from a single-acting one?
Explain how a 5/2 directional valve works.
How do I size a hydraulic cylinder for a given force?
I uploaded a pneumatic circuit. Explain the sequence of motion.
plc: Explain a latching (seal-in) rung in ladder logic.
How does an on-delay timer (TON) work?
How do I write a start/stop motor circuit?
I uploaded a ladder diagram. Explain what it does.
